name: Spin
what: A value carried by the direction of a tiny magnet, an electron's spin: it keeps its value with the power off, so a machine of them can sleep without losing anything, but writing one is slower than switching a gate.
ai: Written by Claude while building #452, to show the form. The traits and the contract are guesses: no fact backs them yet.
words: An example of a proposal. Magnets that keep their value could let a rarely busy sensor sleep for free; nobody has grown a whole machine of them in the lab.
